bug1_refresh_loop.root_cause: DashboardLayout's auth gate fired router.replace('/login') on EVERY render while isAuthenticated was false (no ref/once guard). Going 'back' to a guarded route re-ran it, and the auth callback bounced between /login and the dashboard, producing an endless reload loop.
fixes: auth errors (network/timeout) no longer treated as 'not logged in' -> shows retry UI instead of redirecting back and forth
loading skeleton now also covers 'not hydrated yet' so the gate cannot fire before the session is known
auth callback now redirects to a locale-prefixed path (/en/login or /fa/login) so the proxy does not rewrite it again
locale switch uses router.replace with scroll:false (a soft transition), so switching language no longer triggers a full page reload

bug2_persian_leftovers_on_english.root_cause: Category labels ('هوش مصنوعی', ...), tag/keyword data, and many UI strings were hardcoded Persian literals in TS/TSX and in core/config, so they stayed Persian in the English locale.
fixes: NEWS_CATEGORIES now holds only id+color; labels come from messages/{locale}.json via the new useCategoryLabels hook
every remaining hardcoded UI string (dashboard, news, notes, analytics, settings, feed, quick note, search bar, sidebar, header, error boundary) moved into en.json/fa.json
mock/news sample content translated to English
removed fa-ir formatting defaults (BRAND.locale/direction) and the unused rtl-locked AuthLayout
en.json and fa.json verified at 105 matching keys each
